links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT oropharyngeal cancer responses (FRE, FKRGL) versus recommended 6th grade level
links.effect: Mean FRE and FKRGL both indicated greater than an 11th grade readability level, higher than the 6th grade level recommended for patients.
links.quote: The mean FRE and FKRGL scores both indicated greater than an 11th grade readability level-higher than the 6th grade level recommended for patients.

links.outcome: Physician-graded accuracy, comprehensiveness, and similarity of ChatGPT answers; potential to misinform
links.effect: Mean accuracy 3.88 (SD 0.99), comprehensiveness 3.80 (SD 1.14), similarity to physician 3.67 (SD 1.08); critiques identified potential to misinform patients.
links.quote: ChatGPT responses may not educate patients to an appropriate degree, could outright misinform them, and read at a more difficult grade level than is recommended for patient material.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-3.5 responses to oropharyngeal cancer questions evaluated by physician graders for accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
